verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a payments API platform could offer scoped keys, but the evidence only shows that BVNK lets you generate Hawk API keys (Auth ID plus Secret Key) from the Integrations page. Nothing documents permission scopes, role restrictions or least-privilege limits on those credentials. The agent-wallet-cli probe also says nothing about scoped credentials, and plain key generation is an adjacent feature that earns no credit.
